identity.title: Cambrian-1: A Fully Open, Vision-Centric Exploration of Multimodal LLMs

problem.claim: Design and improve multimodal LLMs with accurate visual grounding, especially in real-world scenarios.

gap.claim: Vision-component design in MLLMs is often underexplored and disconnected from visual representation learning, hindering sensory grounding.

contributions.claim: Evaluates more than 15 self-supervised, strongly supervised, and hybrid vision models through LLM-based visual instruction tuning.
Proposes Spatial Vision Aggregator, a dynamic spatially aware connector that integrates vision features with LLMs while reducing token counts.
Provides an open MLLM cookbook with model weights, code, tools, datasets, and instruction-tuning and evaluation recipes, alongside guidance on balanced visual instruction data.

stated_novelty.claim: Presents a fully open, vision-centric exploration of multimodal LLM design, including systematic visual-representation comparisons and the SVA connector.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The study reports experiments involving more than 15 vision models across multiple representation-learning regimes.
The authors report state-of-the-art performance for Cambrian-1.

narrative_sequence.summary: The paper identifies underexplored, disconnected vision-component choices as a barrier to accurate sensory grounding.
It evaluates diverse visual representations through an LLM and visual-instruction-tuning interface.
It introduces SVA to provide dynamic, spatially aware visual feature integration with fewer tokens.
It discusses balanced instruction-data curation and releases an open set of models, code, datasets, tools, and recipes.

source_observation.claim: The abstract separates visual-representation analysis, benchmark interpretation, connector design, and data-distribution balancing as linked parts of MLLM development.

lessons.interpretation: This suggests framing multimodal-system work as an interaction among representation, interface, evaluation, and data choices.
lessons.application: Organize a future paper around these choice categories and report how each is evaluated or constrained.
lessons.exception: This framing may be unsuitable for a narrowly scoped study focused on one component or task.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the benchmark tasks, metrics, baselines, or conditions supporting the state-of-the-art claim.
It does not report quantitative gains, token reductions, or ablations for SVA.
The benchmark critique’s concrete recommendations and the effects of distribution balancing are unspecified.
